title: ATS Announces Election of Directors and Activity Under NCIB
summary: ATS Corporation (TSX: ATS) (NYSE: ATS) (“ ATS ” or the “ Company ”) today announced that all of the nominee directors listed in the management information circular dated June 22, 2026 were elected as directors of ATS. The vote was conducted electronically at the virtual Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders, which took place on August 6, 2026 (“ Annual Meeting ”).
